meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 当您询问未发布更改时，Claude 会比较当前代码与最新已发布的 npm 版本，把改动按组件、opencode、codex 等发布层分类，用“新增/修复/重构”描述真实差异，并推荐每层的版本号。它会直接输出，不提问。
howto.when: 当您提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等词，或要求查看未发布改动时触发。

say.text: 检查一下有没有未发布的更改
say.note: 会对比本地与npm版本并列出改动。

say.text: 生成一份变更日志，按组件和工具分层
say.note: 会按发布层分类并推荐版本号。

say.text: 自上次发布后项目改了什么？
say.note: 触发技能并输出改动列表。

howto.what_en: It compares HEAD with the latest npm releases, groups changes by layer (pure components, opencode, codex), describes actual diffs as feat/fix/refactor, and recommends per-layer version bumps. Outputs immediately, no questions.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or requests to view unpublished changes.

say_en.note: It compares HEAD with npm releases and lists them.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog grouped by component and tool
say_en.note: It classifies by release layer and suggests version bumps.

say_en.text: What changed since the last release?
say_en.note: Runs the skill and outputs the changes.
